name: The Peasants' Crown
about: Bread riots in a great lord's town become a rising of the poor under a hedge-priest who wears a crown of straw. Feed them, break them, or bargain, and watch which lords decide the poor are a weapon.
title: The Peasants' Crown

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: The price of bread in {town} doubles in a month. A crowd breaks the doors of {lord}'s grain store, and {lord}'s men break the crowd.

court.text: {lord} of {lord.house}: "The rabble of {town} attacked my stores, Your Grace. I want the crown's leave to hang every one of them."

options.label: Open the royal granaries to {town} (200 gold)
options.result: Royal grain reaches {town}. The crowd that broke the stores queues quietly for bread.

options.label: Give {lord} leave to hang the ringleaders
options.result: Seven are hanged in {town}'s square. That night, someone paints a crown on the gallows.

options.label: Fix the price of bread by royal decree
options.result: The King fixes the price of bread in {town}. The merchants hide their flour.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: A hedge-priest crowned with straw preaches in the fields outside {town}: no lords, no tithes, every man his own bread. Thousands come to hear him, and they bring their scythes.

court.text: {opportunist} of {opportunist.house}: "The poor of {town} have a king of their own now, Your Grace. Someone will use them, if the crown doesn't settle it."

options.label: Hear the straw king's grievances at Kingsmere (300 gold)
options.hint: a lower tithe for the poor · {lord.houseName} −20
options.result: The straw king comes to Kingsmere under the King's safe-conduct, and goes home with a charter for {town}.

options.label: Send knights to scatter them
options.result: Knights ride into the crowd outside {town}. They scatter it, and fill a ditch.

beats.speaker: opportunist
beats.text: {opportunist} takes up the straw king's cause, and the poor of the realm march behind {opportunist.house}'s banner on Kingsmere, promised bread and no tithes.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: Fed, {town} goes back to work. The straw crown is never woven.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: The charter of {town} is read in every square in the realm. The poor go home with something in writing, and the straw king hangs his crown above a church door.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: The rising is broken. The poor go back to the fields, and the songs about the straw king go underground, where songs last longest.
